OSH stream and task launch vectors (aienos-mv#430), copied byte for byte, not edited.
Label: host only (tests/test_osh_op.c part 3); nothing here ran on a Spark, Pi 5, iMac or any real machine.

Source:  aien-dev/aien-protocols-mv, branch feat/osh-stream-abi-43, commit 181855c9ff3ec9bcc635d2043d5d7d213cee6021
         (STREAM_TASK.md revision 2), directory specs/osh-platform/vectors.
Runner:  test_osh_op part 3 drives each vector through osh_op_exec over the C stand-in stages and prints
         OSHSV1_RUN and OSHSV1_CONFORMANCE lines. A vector is NOT_RUN, with its reason printed, when it needs something
         this adapter does not provide: the domain 2 binding (this adapter's spawn authority is the kernel IPC table,
         domain 1), the `streams` feature, a binding override or a stream slot the runner does not drive, or a command
         the runner does not implement. Run on 2026-10-18: pass=3 (t002, t008, t009), fail=0, not_run=13.
